resolved.title: 数据集操作
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Set Operation[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Occasionally, you might need to combine data from multiple tables into one comprehensive dataset. This may be for tables with similar data within the same database or maybe there is a need to combine similar data across databases or even across servers. 

To accomplish this, use the [b]UNION [/b]and [b]UNION ALL[/b] operators. 

[b]UNION [/b]combines multiple datasets into a single dataset, and removes any existing duplicates.
[b]UNION ALL[/b] combines multiple datasets into one dataset, but does not remove duplicate rows. 
[note]UNION ALL is faster than UNION, as it does not perform the duplicate removal operation over the data set.[/note]

content.text:
偶尔，你可能需要将多个表的数据合并成一个综合数据表。可能是针对同一数据库中具有类似数据的表，或者可能需要跨数据库甚至跨服务器合并类似的数据。

为了实现这个目的，可以使用**联合查询**和**UNION**操作符。

**UNION**将多个数据集合并为一个数据集，并删除任何现有的重复数据。
**UNION ALL**将多个数据集合并为一个数据集，但不删除重复的行。

resolved.title: UNION
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]UNION[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]UNION [/b]operator is used to combine the result-sets of two or more SELECT statements.

All SELECT statements within the UNION must have the [b]same number of columns[/b]. The columns must also have the same[b] data types[/b]. Also, the columns in each SELECT statement must be in the same order.
[s0l0!-header][b]The syntax of UNION is as follows:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT column_name(s) FROM table1
[b]UNION[/b]
SELECT column_name(s) FROM table2;[/code]
[s0l0!-header]Here is the [b]First [/b]of two tables:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2840" width="100%"][s0l0!-header]
And here is the [b]Second[/b]:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2841" width="100%"]
[code format="sql" codeId="3067"]SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City FROM First
[b]UNION[/b]
SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City FROM Second;[/code]
[s0l0!-header]The resulting table will look like this one:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2842" width="100%"]
[note]As you can see, the duplicates have been removed.[/note]
[s0l0!-header][b]TIP:[/b][/s0l0!-header]
If your columns don't match exactly across all queries, you can use a [b]NULL (or any other)[/b] value such as: [code format="sql" ]SELECT FirstName, LastName, Company FROM businessContacts
UNION
SELECT FirstName, LastName, [b]NULL [/b]FROM otherContacts;[/code]
[note]The UNION operator is used to combine the result-sets of two or more SELECT statements.[/note]

resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定两张数据表（列字段均一样）：

表**norwaychess**：

![](/content/assets/baf33ac418cd93212f45.jpeg)

表**tatasteel**:

![](/content/assets/c39bea4cb6d87e1ff4b8.jpeg)

请写一个查询来合并**norwaychess**和**tatasteel**表。
然后将合并后的表按列`rating`降序排列，并显示最终的结果
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]UNION[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

FIDE wants to hold a major chess tournament and has decided to include players from the [b]Norway Chess[/b] and [b]Tata Steel[/b] tournaments.
Table [b]NorwayChess[/b]  [img id="4546" width="100%"] Table [b]TataSteel[/b] [img id="4548" width="100%"]
Write a query to merge 'NorwayChess' and 'TataSteel' tables. Then order the merged table by 'Rating' in descending order and show the final table of participants.
[note]Remember, you need to get a table [b]without duplicates[/b].[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 记住，你需要得到一个**没有重复**记录的结果。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT * FROM  norwaychess
UNION 
SELECT * FROM tatasteel
ORDER BY rating DESC;
